title: OpenStack keystone
description: Configuration for the Keystone identity service (OpenStack-Helm keystone, release 2025.1). Only the fields here are settable on a Composition; everything else uses the chart defaults in values.yaml. Deploy all the OpenStack component blueprints into one namespace to form a complete install.

tags.title: Image tag overrides
tags.description: Override specific component images (e.g. a keystone image that ships mod_auth_openidc for OIDC federation).

keystone_api.title: Keystone API image
keystone_api.description: Full image ref for the keystone-api container, e.g. ghcr.io/braghettos/keystone-oidc:2025.1-ubuntu_jammy.

network.title: Network
network.description: External exposure of the Keystone API. The OIDC redirect chain runs through the browser, so Keystone must be reachable at a public HTTPS hostname. NodePort is the low-friction path; production fronts it with an ingress/Gateway that terminates TLS.

enabled.title: Expose the API on a NodePort

conf.title: OpenStack-Helm conf overrides
conf.description: OIDC federation overrides merged into the keystone conf tree. NB: this subtree is intentionally shallow-typed with preserve-unknown-fields on the free-form parts (wsgi_keystone, federation) because the upstream OSH conf tree is large and irregular and does not round-trip cleanly through crdgen (see schema-extension-plan.md, crdgen risk).

remote_id_attribute.title: Remote ID attribute
remote_id_attribute.description: Apache env var carrying the token issuer, e.g. HTTP_OIDC_ISS.

wsgi_keystone.title: Keystone Apache vhost
wsgi_keystone.description: Full Apache vhost template (mod_auth_openidc OIDC RP config + protected federation Locations). Helm-templated (uses helm-toolkit endpoint lookups).
